title: Sales Associate
description: Serve customers on the shop floor at the Trincity supermarket, keep shelves stocked, and help shoppers find grocery and household items during weekday and weekend shifts.
highlights: Full-time shifts, including one weekend day
Training on the till and customer service
howToApply: Apply on the Massy Stores website. Mention the Sales Associate role at Trincity Mall and include a phone number where the store can reach you.

title: Customer Service Representative
description: Handle walk-in and phone enquiries at a Port of Spain branch, open and service accounts, and resolve routine banking requests while following Republic Bank's compliance checks.
highlights: Branch role in Port of Spain
Customer service or cashier experience is useful
howToApply: Submit an application through the Republic Bank website. Include a résumé and say you are applying for the Customer Service Representative vacancy in Port of Spain.

title: Airport Services Agent
description: Check in passengers, tag baggage, and answer flight questions at Piarco International Airport. The roster includes early mornings, evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
highlights: Shift work, including weekends and public holidays
howToApply: Apply on the Caribbean Airlines website and select the Airport Services Agent vacancy for Piarco. Have identification and a résumé ready before you start the form.
